chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30 with short black hair and a short trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman around 28 wearing a burgundy hijab, a long cream knitted cardigan over an olive-green dress

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern Moroccan apartment living room. WIFE stands by a sideboard holding banknotes she just pulled out of HUSBAND's open brown leather wallet, caught in the act; she turns toward him and shouts angrily, face clearly visible. HUSBAND stands in the doorway pointing at the wallet, shocked. Both seen head to waist, subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sits alone on a Moroccan salon sofa in the evening, arms folded, eyes narrowed, calmly plotting a plan, a sly half smile. Warm lamp light, Moroccan cushions.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND on a small apartment balcony at night overlooking a Moroccan city with minarets, rubbing his beard, doubtful and thoughtful, wondering if he is being unfair.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Dinner at a small round Moroccan table with a tagine and tea glasses. HUSBAND, smiling generously, gestures with an open hand toward WIFE, offering her a deal; WIFE listens surprised and pleased. Both faces visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same apartment kitchen. WIFE nods happily with a big smile, hands clasped, agreeing. HUSBAND watches her with raised eyebrows, suspicious.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND holds up a long supermarket receipt and a pile of bills at the kitchen table, proposing to split the costs in half, pointing at the receipt; WIFE leans back, her smile fading.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE stands with arms crossed, wagging her finger and shaking her head firmly, refusing; HUSBAND sits frozen holding the receipt, mouth open in disbelief. Comic, expressive faces.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: WIFE lounges on the sofa scrolling short self-help videos on her phone, nodding along convinced; HUSBAND stands behind the sofa looking at the phone over her shoulder, unimpressed. The phone screen shows only abstract colours.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: WIFE lectures HUSBAND confidently with raised index finger in the living room, as if giving a speech; HUSBAND facepalms with one hand, exhausted and amused. Light comic mood.
